No Online Game Registered Under New Gaming Law, 201 Complaints Logged

The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology said that no online game has been registered under India's new gaming law. It reported receiving 201 complaints related to the law. The ministry conveyed this information to the Competition Commission of India. Multiple Indian news outlets published the ministry's statements. The reports did not indicate any registrations or resolutions to date.
